A narrow old-neighbourhood lane in India at dusk in steady rain, a warm street lamp upper-right lighting the wet ground. From the left his mother rushes in under an umbrella, kneels, and wraps him in a hug under the umbrella; he relaxes into her. Warm, gentle ending. Only the sound of rain; no speech, no music.
